text:
Jonah M.: Hey design — we need a small batch of launch assets for the 'Serving Wins' benchmark + a webinar promo. Goal: social teaser, blog hero, webinar hero, 3 microtiles (latency / cost / reliability), and a routing-ready banner for inbound pages. Deadline: next Wed EOD.
Maya D.: Ack — can you confirm final messaging variants? also do we need localized sizes?
Jonah M.: Primary messaging: 'Predictable, cost-efficient LLM inference at scale.' Variant A (concise): 'Serve LLMs — fast, reliable, economical.' Variant B (technical): 'Optimized runtime + routing = predictable latency and 40% lower token cost (vs naive serving).' No localization for first wave.
Priya S.: Add short webinar CTA: 'Live: Behind the serving runtime — real numbers & tradeoffs.' Also we need a 1-line subhead for the blog hero: 'Benchmarks and playbooks to reduce per-token spend.'
Lucas R.: For inbound routing banner, we need 3 widths: 1200x300 (header), 820x312 (fb share), 300x600 (sidebar). Also add a small CTA overlay for A/B capture: 'Get the benchmark pack'.
Maya D.: Cool. I'm going to draft 2 visual directions: Modern data viz-forward and Product-led schematic. Which should I prioritize?
Jonah M.: Prioritize data viz-forward for the microtiles and blog hero; schematic for the webinar hero so we can show routing/fallback flow.
Sam K.: Timeline: I can mock the data viz tiles by Mon, refine Tue. Need the exact numbers to show on sparklines and cost comparisons.
Priya S.: Use these numbers (all approximate): baseline latency median 120ms, tuned runtime median 32ms; per-token cost baseline $0.018 -> tuned $0.011. For the slide microcopy: '40% lower token cost' (rounded).
Maya D.: thx. dropping figma frames in a sec. Any brand constraints beyond core palette and type?
Jonah M.: Brand guardrails: use primary palette only, no alternate accent colors. Follow type hierarchy from Brand Kit v2 (no condensed weights). Include logo lockup + standard clearspace. Legal: add small footnote: 'Benchmark tests run on p4d single-shard configs; results may vary.'
Maya D.: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/serving-wins-bench-v1 — frames: /microtiles /hero-webinar /header-banners. Comments enabled.
Lucas R.: FYI, inbound pixel team prefers the 1200x300 exported as PNG-24 and a separate 2x for retina. Also ask analytics to provide final tracking tag.
ops-bot: Created ticket #MK-4821 for creative deliverables (assignee: Maya D., due: 2026-02-10).
Sam K.: Quick spec for exports (copy for the ticket):
```
webinar_hero: 1600x800 jpg (web), 1600x800 png (high-contrast)
blog_hero: 1200x628 jpg
social_teaser: 1200x630 png
microtile: 400x280 png (3 variants)
banner_header: 1200x300 png + 2400x600 @2x
sidebar: 300x600 png
```
Maya D.: I'll start comps tonight. Can Priya paste the final shortlines into the figma copy blocks?
Priya S.: On it — I'll add exact copy and the footnote, plus alt-text drafts for accessibility.
Jonah M.: Thanks team. Ping me in-thread when Figma frames ready for review. :rocket:
